title: Servio Tool Error Response
description: Standard error envelope returned by the tool execution endpoint on failure (HTTP 4xx or 5xx). AI agents should parse 'code' for programmatic handling and 'message' for self-correction.

success.description: Always false for error responses. Use this flag to distinguish success from error.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. AI agents should use this for programmatic error handling.

message.description: Human-readable error description written to help the AI agent self-correct. Should explain what went wrong and, where possible, what the agent should do next.
examples: No authentication token provided. Use OAuth 2.0 flow.
This tool requires the 'write' scope. Please re-authorize with the required permissions.
Rate limit exceeded: 50 requests per minute. Retry after 47 seconds.

data.description: Optional supplemental data. Present for certain error codes (e.g. rate_limited includes retry timing).

retry_after.description: Seconds until the rate limit window resets. Present when code is 'rate_limited'.

limit.description: Maximum allowed requests in the current window.

current.description: Current request count in the window.

status.description: HTTP status code (present in WordPress REST API error responses).

examples.message: No authentication token provided. Use OAuth 2.0 flow.
Rate limit exceeded: 50 requests per minute
This tool requires the 'write' scope. Please re-authorize with the required permissions.
